reference.method: Read-only matched executable/PDB metadata and direct branch/jump-table inspection; no native code execution. This artifact contains conclusions and address anchors, not code bytes or disassembly.

facts.topic: FinishedChargingItem is a local input-reset event
facts.contract: ActorEvent74 is FinishedChargingItem in the matched PDB. LocalPlayer::handleEntityEvent dispatches it to a store of true in Player.mFlagClientForBAIReset at offset0xCA8. It then follows the base Mob/Actor handlers; both select their default branch for74 and the Actor branch returns without changing item-use state.
anchors: LocalPlayer::handleEntityEvent RVA0x476DAC0; jump-table RVA0xE8E333C, index74-35 -> RVA0x476DCCF
flag store RVA0x476DCCF; base handler jump RVA0x476DCCA -> RVA0x207E4F0
Mob jump-table RVA0xE7FBF14, index74-2 -> RVA0x207E89A; base jump RVA0x207E8AA -> RVA0x1A085B0

facts.topic: Input reset waits for charged-item state
facts.contract: handleBuildAction first asks the selected stack whether it has a charged item. If that result is true and mFlagClientForBAIReset is true, it invokes IClientInstance::clearInProgressBAI, clears the flag, and returns from that input handling path. The reset therefore waits if FinishedChargingItem precedes the inventory update that supplies chargedItem. The branch does not call releaseUsingItem or stopUsingItem.
anchors: ItemStackBase::hasChargedItem call RVA0x5D94F66 -> RVA0x2482F90; saved result at stack+0xD7
charged-state check RVA0x5D950F8; reset-flag check RVA0x5D95101
clearInProgressBAI call RVA0x5D95117; flag clear RVA0x5D95124; return-path branch RVA0x5D9512B -> RVA0x5D95CB9

facts.topic: Successful loaded-item use clears retained input
facts.contract: The post-baseUseItem success path also checks the pre-use hasChargedItem result and invokes clearInProgressBAI when that result was true. This is separate from the server event latch; it does not prove the local item succeeds for every malformed or custom loaded-stack definition.

perlin_change: The local ChargedItem event is retained in session state until the selected crossbow is loaded, then blocks continuation from the same held press. The existing active-use timer continues; no ItemRelease is fabricated. Physical release clears the completed-use continuation latch, allowing one ordinary loaded-item attempt on a fresh press.
validation: PlayerInteractionSelfTest exercises event-before-inventory and inventory-before-event order, active timer preservation, completion without same-press firing, a fresh loaded shot, and no repeated firing from the old completion latch. ItemUsePacketsSelfTest exercises other-actor/no-local-player filtering, consume-once behavior and session reset. Integration run is owned by the parent agent.
limits: The native addresses establish this branch in supplied protocol2193 only. Other profiles exercise Perlin interoperability tests, not independent native equivalence.
The branch clearing retained input does not itself establish all crossbow load, release, projectile or custom-item behavior.
